title: Temperature Dependence of Volume Changes on Mixing Electrolyte Solutions (H. E. Wirth and A. LoSurdo)
experimental_method: Densities of 4-ionic-strength solutions of Li2SO4, LiCl, Na2SO4, NaCl and their mixtures measured 5-45 C with a Vycor mercury-filling dilatometer in a thermostated bath; volume changes on mixing from single-mixing unequal-volume dilatometers near 12, 25 and 38 C.
uncertainties_stated: Absolute densities believed reliable to +-3e-5 g/mL; bath constant to +-0.005 C; thermometers calibrated against a platinum resistance thermometer.
quality_remarks: The PDF begins with another article (relative adsorptivities of paraffins on molecular sieves) on its first page, and ends with an unrelated ceramics article; Wirth and LoSurdo run on PDF pages 2-6. Densities were adjusted to match 25 C values of an earlier paper (ref 3); t = 0 C densities are least-squares extrapolations. Table IV rows at 25.0 C marked a are calculated. Temperature scale and pressure not stated. Subscript last digits of temperatures and D' are tiny on the scan. Table 1 densities were adjusted to agree with the authors' earlier 25 C values (p.227). Mixture molalities in the mapping are derived from the printed equivalent fraction E.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (constants of the density equation, fitted)
Table III (constants of the apparent equivalent volume equation, fitted)
